identity.name: Kingdom of Henan (Eighteen Kingdoms)
alt_names: Kingdom of Henan under Xiang Yu

land.text: 灭秦后，项羽分韩国为河南国，封申阳为河南王，建都洛阳 (zh 申阳); 'granted part of the former Hán kingdom's territory' (Shen Yang page); 'northwestern Henan' (Eighteen Kingdoms table)

predecessors.note: The Shen Yang page ties the domain to the former Hán kingdom's territory; the Eighteen Kingdoms table gives 'northwestern Henan'; the zh 申阳 page puts the capital at Luoyang. The Qin held it at the end. Land given as a 90 km disc around Luoyang, not Cliopatria's Henan outline (which lies on Henei; see keyframe_review/0).

land.text: 汉二年（前205年）十一月，申阳投降汉王刘邦，其地成为河南郡 (zh 申阳); the kingdom 'became the Henan Commandery of the Hàn Empire' (Shen Yang page)

successors.note: Shen Yang page: 'In 205 BC, Shen Yang surrendered to Liu Bang'; his kingdom 'became the Henan Commandery of the Hàn Empire'. The Timeline page dates the surrender 206. Henan Commandery page: 'in 205 BC, Sanchuan was renamed Henan', seat Luoyang. Land given as a 90 km disc around Luoyang, not Cliopatria's Henan outline.

capitals.name: Luoyang
capitals.note: Chinese Wikipedia, 申阳: '项羽分韩国为河南国,封申阳为河南王,建都洛阳' (the English Shen Yang page names no capital). Luoyang lies about 60 km west of Cliopatria's Henan polygon, inside Cliopatria's Hán shape (reviewer's polygon test, 2026-10-19): the Cliopatria outline is not the Luoyang kingdom; see keyframe_review/0.

rulers.name: Shen Yang
rulers.note: Succession box '206 BC - unknown'; the reign ends with the surrender to Liu Bang in 205.

correction.text: 项羽分韩国为河南国，封申阳为河南王，建都洛阳 ... 其地成为河南郡: the kingdom of Shen Yang around Luoyang (Qin's Sanchuan, the later Henan Commandery), for 206-205 only; 90 km disc around Luoyang as a soft proxy

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's Henan shape (40,946 km2, bbox 112.0-115.7 E, 34.0-36.4 N) is displaced: it lies on Henei, the land of Yin around Zhaoge (about 114.2 E 35.6 N), not on Shen Yang's kingdom around Luoyang (112.47 E 34.68 N). The earlier note 'with Luoyang inside' was false: the bbox contains Luoyang, the polygon does not. Polygon test (reviewer, 2026-10-19): Luoyang lies 60 km outside the polygon, inside Cliopatria's Hán shape; 11 percent of a 90 km disc around Luoyang lies in the Henan shape, against 95 percent of a 90 km disc around Zhaoge; 78 percent of the shape lies north of 35.0 N and 75 percent east of 113.5 E. The Cliopatria Henan cells therefore belong to Yin (yin dossier, ea-02-c, not yet written), not to this kingdom. Pages reopened 2026-10-19: zh 申阳 '项羽分韩国为河南国，封申阳为河南王，建都洛阳' and '汉二年（前205年）十一月，申阳投降汉王刘邦，其地成为河南郡' (no boundaries given); en Shen Yang: 'granted part of the former Hán kingdom's territory'; Henan Commandery page (second page, not cited by the verdict): 'in 205 BC, Sanchuan was renamed Henan', seat Luoyang, 22 counties from Luoyang and Xingyang to Yanshi, Jing and Pingyin, western half split off as Hongnong in 113 BC. The corrected shape is therefore a 90 km disc around Luoyang (about 25,000 km2), soft: no page bounds the kingdom, and the commandery may reach further west than the disc. Years 206-205 (Cliopatria 206-204; 204 belongs to Han, kingdom-of-han). No page gives an area, so no infobox comparison. Neighbour: Cliopatria's Hán shape (han-2, ea-02-b) holds Luoyang; han-2 should take this disc out of its outline when it is next revised.

region.text: 灭秦后，项羽分韩国为河南国，封申阳为河南王，建都洛阳 (zh 申阳); 'granted part of the former Hán kingdom's territory' (Shen Yang page); 'northwestern Henan' (Eighteen Kingdoms table)

ledger.note: 206: Xiang Yu makes Shen Yang, a Zhao official, King of Henan. 'After the fall of the Qin dynasty in 206 BC, Xiang Yu divided the former Qin Empire' and Shen Yang 'was appointed by Xiang Yu as the King of Henan'; the Eighteen Kingdoms table: 'Henan (河南): Shen Yang (Zhao official); northwestern Henan'. The Xiang Yu page dates the division 'In the spring of 206 BC'. The zh 申阳 page names the capital: '建都洛阳'. Region: a 90 km disc around Luoyang; Cliopatria's Henan outline lies on Henei (Yin's land) and is not used (keyframe_review/0).

region.text: 汉二年（前205年）十一月，申阳投降汉王刘邦，其地成为河南郡 (zh 申阳); the kingdom 'became the Henan Commandery of the Hàn Empire' (Shen Yang page)

ledger.note: 205: Shen Yang surrenders Henan to Liu Bang. 'In 205 BC, Shen Yang surrendered to Liu Bang'; the kingdom 'became the Henan Commandery of the Hàn Empire'. The Chu-Han Contention page agrees ('Shen Yang, the King of Henan, surrendered to Liu Bang' in 205, in the paragraph of Liu Bang's advance past Hangu Pass); the Timeline page lists it under 206 BC. No month on any page. The zh 申阳 page: '汉二年（前205年）十一月' (the reviewer reads the 11th month of Han year 2 as about Dec 206 - Jan 205, which would explain the Timeline's 206); no month stored.

region.text: 汉二年（前205年）十一月，申阳投降汉王刘邦，其地成为河南郡 (zh 申阳); the kingdom 'became the Henan Commandery of the Hàn Empire' (Shen Yang page)

ledger.note: 205: the Kingdom of Henan ends as Henan Commandery. The page puts the commandery in the same sentence as the 205 surrender but gives no separate date for the change. Henan Commandery page: 'in 205 BC, Sanchuan was renamed Henan', seat Luoyang.

wars.name: Chu-Han Contention

zones.text: Henan around Luoyang, which Shen Yang surrendered to Liu Bang (其地成为河南郡, zh 申阳)

wars.outcome: Han victory (infobox '206-202 BCE'). Henan changed hands by surrender in 205, without a battle on the pages opened.
wars.note: The Chu-Han Contention page does not say the kingdom became a commandery; the Shen Yang page does.

certainty.note: The kingdom was assigned by Xiang Yu from commanderies; no page gives boundaries or a survey. The Luoyang disc is a soft proxy; Cliopatria's Henan outline (Henei) is not used.

notes:
Wikidata Q5349053 is the Eighteen Kingdoms item shared by twelve Cliopatria rows; Henan is its own kingdom (Shen Yang), so it keeps its own dossier.
Date conflict: the Shen Yang and Chu-Han Contention pages give 205 for the surrender, the Timeline page 206; the zh 申阳 page gives 汉二年（前205年）十一月. 205 is used (three pages). The Cliopatria row runs to 204, which the dossier cuts to 205; the matching gain belongs in kingdom-of-han (its ledger has gains from yong, sai, zhai, wei, dai and yin in 205 but none from henan) and the compiler should give the Luoyang cells to Han from 205.
Capital: Luoyang, from the zh 申阳 page ('建都洛阳'); the English Shen Yang page names none.
Placement (repair pass, 2026-10-19): Cliopatria's Henan polygon lies on Henei around Zhaoge, the land of Yin, not on Luoyang (see keyframe_review/0); the verdict is wrong and the corrected region, used in the ledger, the war zone and the predecessor/successor land, is a 90 km disc around Luoyang ({"place": "Luoyang", "km": 90}), soft. Cliopatria's Henan cells should be drawn as Yin (ea-02-c). The region name 'Henan (region)' resolves to the whole province (about 206,000 km2) and is not used.
